label.en: Proportions: Inequality, two independent groups (Boschloo's unconditional exact test)
label.de: Anteile: Ungleichheit, zwei unabhängige Gruppen (unbedingter exakter Test nach Boschloo)

aliases: unconditional exact test of two independent binomial proportions ordered by the Fisher p-value

hypothesis.H1: p1 != p2 (variants minlike and central), p1 < p2 (variant less) or p1 > p2 (variant greater)
hypothesis.model: X1 ~ Bin(n1, p1) for group 1 and X2 ~ Bin(n2, p2) for group 2, independent, with fixed group sizes n1 and n2; x1 and x2 count events
hypothesis.power_definition: exact power: double binomial sum over the rejection region {tables whose rigorous upper bound of the Boschloo p-value is at most alpha}

methods.modes_evidence: inferguidR offers a priori (smallest design of the declared allocation sequence, every design from the smallest one evaluated) and post hoc (power of a fixed design). Sensitivity, criterion and compromise are not offered: for the two-sided variants power has one branch on each side of p1, and alpha acts only through discrete rejection regions. No G*Power procedure exists whose modes could be demonstrated.

values.label: Two-sided, central (twice the smaller one-sided p-value)

options.default_evidence: no default: the variant is always stated explicitly (blueprint BOSCHLOO.md; engine-decisions-aux.md 2.11)
options.result_affecting_note: yes: ordering statistic, sidedness and two-sided construction
options.notes: Variant ids boschloo_minlike, boschloo_central, boschloo_lower and boschloo_upper (boschloo_variants()). minlike equals Exact tsmethod 'square'; central doubles the smaller one-sided p-value, whereas Exact doubles the one-sided p-value in the observed direction (the two differ only for equal sample proportions).

options.result_affecting_note: yes: defines the admissible designs of the a priori search
options.notes: r = allocation_ratio = n2 / n1. Both sequences never decrease a group size.

effect_size.definition: the two event probabilities entered directly (group 1 is the reference group); baseline-plus-effect input (difference p2 - p1, ratio p2 / p1, odds ratio) is converted by boschloo_probabilities()

outputs: Attained size (supremum of the null rejection probability over the common event probability)

a_priori: Total sample size and group sizes of the first design of the allocation sequence whose power reaches the target
Achieved power and attained size of that design
Enumeration evidence of minimality (every earlier design evaluated)
post_hoc: Power and attained size of the given design
